Author: Pankaj Purohit
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari, Pankaj Purohit
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRLA No. 299 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
(1) Ms. Manisha Bhandari, learned counsel for the appellant.
(2) Mr. J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State of Uttarakhand.

(3) This appeal is filed under Section 374 of Cr.P.C. against the judgment and order dated 30.01.2024 rendered by learned Additional District & Session Judge/FTSC (POCSO), Dehradun in Sessions Trial No. 100 of 2019, whereby appellant has been convicted under Sections 376, 354A of I.P.C. and Section 10 of the POCSO Act.

He has been directed to undergo twenty years rigorous imprisonment under Sections 376 of I.P.C. with fine of 50,000/- and, in default of payment of fine,
he was to undergo further three months additional simple imprisonment; he has also been sentenced to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment under Section 354A of I.P.C. with fine of 5,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he was to undergo further one month additional simple imprisonment and he has been further sentenced to undergo five years rigorous imprisonment under Section 10 of POCSO Act with fine of 5,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he was to undergo one month additional simple imprisonment.
It was provided that all the sentences shall run concurrently.
(5) As per Office report, there is delay of 65 days in filing this appeal.
(6) The delay in filing the appeal is not opposed by learned State Counsel.
(7) For the reason indicated in the delay condonation application, the daily in filing the appeal is condoned.
Accordingly, delay condonation application (IA No. 2 of 2024) is allowed.
(9) Let trial court record be summoned.
